lines.text: Water. It is time for some.
This is a reminder to drink water.
{{glasses}} {{glassWord}} today. That is the number.
The interval has elapsed.
You are a container. It is low.
Water is available. It usually is.
This message appears every so often. This is one of those times.
There is a glass. It is empty. That is the problem.
The reminder is still here. Nothing has changed.
{{goalPct}}% of the goal. The remainder is the rest.
You have not had water since the last time you had water.
This is the second message. There is a third.
Time continues to pass. So does the dehydration.
Day {{streak}}. The streak is a number that goes up when you drink.
No new information. Same water. Same you.
The tap is in the same place it was this morning.
This message will not go away.
The reminder has escalated. That is what it does.
Drinking the water ends this. Nothing else does.
You are reading a reminder instead of drinking water.
It got louder. It will not get quieter.
Water. In a glass. Into you.
Hydration is mostly repetition.
This will happen again later.
